national_news.title: Union Health Minister Reviews Infrastructure Progress at Lady Hardinge Medical College and Associated Hospitals
bullets: Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare JP Nadda reviewed infrastructure and healthcare expansion projects at Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC), Sucheta Kriplani Hospital (SSKH), and Kalawati Saran Children's Hospital (KSCH).
The augmentation project at Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital aims to increase bed capacity from 394 to 894 beds, ICU capacity from 40 to 200 beds, and Operation Theatres from 4 to 12.
The review also highlighted the state-of-the-art Skill Lab for simulation-based training and the newly functional Augmented Level III-B Neonatal Care Centre with 80 intensive care beds.

national_news.title: India Marks 10th Anniversary of 2016 Surgical Strikes
bullets: India marked the 10th anniversary of the 2016 surgical strikes carried out by the Indian Army across the Line of Control (LoC) in PoJK.
The strikes were launched on September 28-29, 2016, as a direct military response to the Uri terror attack that claimed the lives of 19 Indian soldiers.
The government highlighted a decade of evolving security measures, citing subsequent actions like the 2019 Balakot airstrike and adherence to a zero-tolerance policy against terrorism.

national_news.title: Nation Pays Tribute to Shaheed Bhagat Singh on 119th Birth Anniversary
bullets: The nation observed the 119th birth anniversary of legendary freedom fighter Shaheed-e-Azam Bhagat Singh.
Born on this day in 1907 in Banga village (now in Pakistan), he sacrificed his life alongside Rajguru and Sukhdev for India's independence.
State-level events, including 'Jashn-e-Inquilab', were organized at Punjab Agricultural University in Ludhiana to honor his legacy.

national_news.title: Asian Games 2026: Esha Singh Wins Silver in 25m Pistol
bullets: India's 21-year-old shooter Esha Singh won the silver medal in the women's 25-metre pistol individual event at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
Pincky Balhara secured a bronze medal in the women's under-78kg Kurash event by defeating South Korea's Lim Garam.
Boxer Lovlina Borgohain also secured a medal in the 75kg category, contributing to India's overall medal tally.

national_news.title: Centre to Send Inter-Ministerial Teams to Karnataka and Maharashtra to Assess Drought
bullets: The Central Government announced the dispatch of teams to Karnataka and Maharashtra to assess the drought situation following declarations by the respective state governments.
Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that a Central team will visit Karnataka on October 3rd.
The Union Minister also announced the nationwide 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan' campaign to promote balanced fertilizer application based on Soil Health Card recommendations.

bihar_news.title: India Issues First PRAMAAN Certificates Under Forest Certification Scheme
bullets: India issued its first PRAMAAN certificates under the Indian Forest and Wood Certification Scheme (IFWCS) on September 29, 2026.
Certificates were awarded to the Andhra Pradesh Forest Development Corporation and a bamboo farmer from Odisha.

The scheme was launched in December 2023 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change to promote sustainable forest management, agroforestry, and align with global standards like the EU Deforestation Regulation.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Tourism and ONDC Launch National Digital Tourism Stack
bullets: The Ministry of Tourism and Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) launched the National Digital Tourism Stack (NDTS) on World Tourism Day 2026.
The initiative features a 'list once, reach multiple platforms' model to improve discoverability for homestays, guides, and smaller tourism providers.
The tourism sector contributed 5.22 per cent to India's GDP and supported 8.46 crore jobs in 2023-24 according to Ministry of Tourism data.

bihar_news.title: Indian Railways Disrupts Train Services for Parallel Rajendra Bridge Commissioning over Ganga
bullets: Indian Railways cancelled 35 trains and diverted 33 others due to non-interlocking (NI) work at Rajendra Pul in Bihar.
The work aims to commission a new 1.9-km parallel rail-cum-road bridge over the Ganga near Mokama, connecting Upper Hathidah, Tal Junction, and Barauni.
The original Rajendra Bridge has been operational since 1959, and its parallel double-line bridge project was approved in the 2015-16 Rail Budget at an estimated cost of ₹1,491.47 crore.

bihar_news.title: ITC Expands Dairy Business and Project Gomukh in Eastern India
bullets: ITC is expanding its fresh dairy business and branded product portfolio in Bihar, West Bengal, and Jharkhand, focusing on packaged milk and value-added items like pouch curd.

Under Project Gomukh, ITC supported approximately 33,300 dairy farmers across more than 560 villages in Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal during FY26 through veterinary services and animal husbandry initiatives.
The company entered the fresh dairy market in 2018 with Aashirvaad milk in Bihar and continues to target the state's loose milk market transition to packaged alternatives.

bihar_news.title: NTPC and EDF Sign 50:50 Joint Venture for Renewable and Pumped Storage Projects
bullets: State-owned NTPC and EDF Power Solutions India signed a 50:50 joint venture agreement on September 25, 2026, to develop renewable energy, hydropower, and pumped storage projects.
The partnership aims to support India's national goal of achieving 100 GW of installed capacity of pumped storage projects by 2036.
The joint venture will operate within India and neighboring countries to build low-carbon power plants and transmission assets.
